overview: I retested Memory's effect on ruling consistency using 6 real vendor compatibility claims and a 9-criterion rubric. Both arms scored 207/207 criteria MET — the measure was flat, not close. Verdict correctness was 4 of 23; the outcome measure was never wired.

keyPoints.title: 207/207 criteria MET in both arms — measure was flat
Only 4 of 23 rulings matched my pre-committed answer key
Rubric's 7-criterion denominator collapses to 2 variable criteria
Cold-start rationales identical in 10 of 11 without Memory
Per-criterion score column was never wired — existential flaw
